summary: Executed backend + frontend regression for RoadMesh incremental features. Backend pytest passed 29/29 (including normalized plate search, managed media upload/download, damage validation/isolation, quote status flow, invoice PDF binary/export auth/isolation, and multi-page PDF generation). Frontend mobile/tablet checks passed for logo rendering (login/register/dashboard/more), plate search flow, quote creation/share/confirm-send/convert, invoice export blob open, 5-tab layout, and no horizontal overflow. One unresolved UI integration issue remains for damage gallery upload automation on web preview.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking `damage-gallery` in Expo web preview did not expose filechooser/input[type=file] to automation; could not complete UI-level gallery upload + preview path in Playwright although backend /api/media + /api/damages works.

integration_issues.flow: Long UI runs intermittently show 'Disconnected from Metro (1006)' in browser console, interrupting later scripted interactions.
integration_issues.issue: Flaky preview session can break chained UI steps after waits/timeouts.

action_items: Investigate Expo web image-picker path for `damage-gallery` so browser automation and web users can reliably choose files (verify generated file input / event wiring).
Stabilize Expo preview session to avoid Metro 1006 disconnect during longer UI workflows.
Optional hardening: remove fallback JWT secret and fail fast when JWT secret env var is missing.
critical_code_review_comments: `backend/server.py` is very large (>900 lines); split into routers/modules for maintainability.
JWT secret currently has a permissive fallback default in code; safer to enforce env-only secret.
Frontend console repeatedly logs deprecated `shadow*` style warning; migrate to `boxShadow` where applicable.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (core flows pass; damage gallery upload UI path unresolved in web automation)

seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST_* records via automated API/UI tests (clients, vehicles, work-orders, quotes, invoices, damages, media). No mocked APIs used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use rodrigo@oficina.pt / teste123. Quote email/WhatsApp interception validated (mailto + wa.me with encoded body). Invoice export from UI opens blob URL and backend returns real PDF. For damage gallery, manual device/web exploratory check still needed because Playwright could not access file chooser on `damage-gallery`.
rca_of_issue: Damage gallery UI issue reproduction: login -> dashboard-search-plate -> select vehicle -> vehicle-damage-fuga -> click `damage-gallery`. In two runs, no filechooser event and no `input[type=file]` appeared (count remained 0). This blocks automated gallery upload verification even though direct backend media upload works; likely Expo image-picker web handoff/event exposure issue in preview runtime.
